projects.title: Songlinker
bullets: Built and kept running a Discord bot that detects music links and rewrites them as cross-platform song links using discord.js and odesli.js.
Packaged the bot with Docker and continuous integration so it could be redeployed reliably as small fixes accumulated over years.

projects.title: Uwuifierbot
bullets: Shipped a text-transforming Discord bot to a small public server audience, maintaining it with Docker packaging and continuous integration.

projects.title: Blahaj
bullets: Built a playful Svelte and Tailwind CSS web app, iterating across 64 commits after early layouts didn't read well on mobile.

leadership.title: Regular Demo Presenter
bullets: Keeps a rotation of small side-project bots and sites running for real users years after launch instead of abandoning them post-demo.
After a bot's userbase kept requesting features through scattered Discord messages, started tracking requests before deciding what to build next.
